normalization: UTF-8 without BOM; CRLF and CR normalized to LF; no original evidence modified.
redaction: All textual S-1 numeric SID patterns and C:\Users\<name> prefixes, including slash and JSON-escaped variants, are replaced in publication copies.
embeddedHashMeaning: Hashes inside captured runner JSON records remain original execution hashes. Per-entry original/published hashes below explicitly map normalization/redaction changes.
excluded: DLLs, executables, targets, copied source trees, caches and private binary SID fixtures.
